llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions match a speech-to-text purpose, but the package metadata fails to declare the required API credential and there are a few configuration choices that increase risk (possible exfiltration target override and on-demand npm execution).

dimensions.detail: The skill's code and SKILL.md implement speech-to-text via Crazyrouter/Whisper, which matches the name/description. However, the registry metadata lists no required environment variables or primary credential while both the SKILL.md and scripts/main.ts require CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY. That metadata omission is an incoherence that matters for permission review.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to transcribing a local audio file by invoking scripts/main.ts with npx tsx. The runtime will read the specified input file and send it to Crazyrouter's audio/transcriptions or audio/translations endpoint along with the CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY. This network submission of the full audio file and API key is expected for an STT proxy, but it means any sensitive audio will leave the host.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no persistent install spec (instruction-only with a single script file). The recommended invocation uses `npx -y tsx`, which dynamically downloads/executes packages from the npm registry on each run — this is common but carries the usual supply-chain/runtime risk compared with preinstalled binaries.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The script requires CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY (and optionally CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL) but the skill metadata did not declare any required env vars or primary credential. Also CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL can be set to an arbitrary host, which would cause audio and the API key to be sent to a different endpoint — this is a plausible dev/test feature but increases exfiltration risk if misconfigured or maliciously set.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not marked always:true and does not modify other skills or system configuration. It only writes a transcript file if --output is used. It does not request persistent elevated platform privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Do not install unless you accept that audio files and your CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY will be uploaded to an external service. Before installing: (1) confirm the registry metadata is corrected to list CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY as a required credential; (2) verify you trust https://crazyrouter.com to receive your audio (and remember the CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL env var can redirect uploads to any host); (3) avoid transcribing sensitive audio or use a throwaway/limited-scope API key; (4) be aware that running via `npx tsx` pulls code from npm at runtime — if you need tighter control, fetch the script and inspect it locally or run in an isolated environment. If any of these are unacceptable, do not install.
